chapter: Small's Paradise, Fletcher Henderson and Horace
title: John Hammond's quiet kindnesses
summary: Dance recounts Hammond paying Sandy Williams's dentist; Caldwell says Marlowe could have gone far had he listened.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

Well, I lent him around $25.00 or something, which was about all I could -- or maybe 50.00, I'm not sure, but -- and I gave it to him. I said, no, I'm not going to lend it to you.
